models.name: Random Forest — Sensor-robust (deployed)
models.conditions: Deployed. Rank within property type (flats 0.8642 vs 0.9047); pair with CO2 sensor repair; surface a reliability flag; re-audit after one heating season.
models.narrative: Random Forest — Sensor-robust (deployed) — missingness: CO2 dropped. AUROC 0.9129, sensitivity 0.8874, PPV 0.6378 at threshold 0.43 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.8642 vs terraced 0.9047. Deployed model — non-linear, best accuracy and the fairest across property types (flats 0.8642). CONDITIONAL: small residual flat gap to monitor; rank within type.

models.name: Logistic Regression — Sensor-robust (interpretable baseline)
models.conditions: Interpretable baseline only — less reliable for flats (0.6784); use the Random Forest for the live ranking and this model for plain-language reasons.
models.narrative: Logistic Regression — Sensor-robust (interpretable baseline) — missingness: CO2 dropped. AUROC 0.8412, sensitivity 0.7726, PPV 0.5855 at threshold 0.51 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.6784 vs terraced 0.8295. Interpretable linear baseline. Much weaker for flats (0.6784) — evidence that a non-linear model, not abandoning flats, closes the equity gap. CONDITIONAL.

models.name: Gradient Boosting — CO2 (native NaN)
models.conditions: Strong alternative; CO2 adds no benefit, so prefer the simpler CO2-free forest unless native missing-handling is specifically required.
models.narrative: Gradient Boosting — CO2 (native NaN) — missingness: native (no imputation). AUROC 0.9151, sensitivity 0.8746, PPV 0.6494 at threshold 0.28 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.8672 vs terraced 0.9067. Handles CO2 dropout natively (no imputation) yet CO2 only shifts AUROC +0.0015 overall — confirming the gap is data-integrity, not predictive.

models.name: Logistic — CO2 mean-imputed
models.conditions: Do not deploy: 38% MNAR CO2 mean-imputed for no lift.
models.narrative: Logistic — CO2 mean-imputed — missingness: global-mean impute + flag. AUROC 0.8427, sensitivity 0.7738, PPV 0.5866 at threshold 0.51 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.6785 vs terraced 0.8321. Naive mean-imputation of a 38%-MNAR channel for no lift — a fragile dependency. NOT READY.

models.name: Logistic — CO2 time-interpolated
models.conditions: Do not deploy: interpolation does not make CO2 informative.
models.narrative: Logistic — CO2 time-interpolated — missingness: per-property interpolation + flag. AUROC 0.8439, sensitivity 0.7744, PPV 0.5879 at threshold 0.51 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.6776 vs terraced 0.8346. Even proper per-property interpolation gives no lift, confirming CO2 is uninformative here. NOT READY.

models.name: Logistic — Nowcast + lag_temp (leakage)
models.conditions: Never deploy: lag_temp is target leakage. Always split by property and exclude lag_temp.
models.narrative: Logistic — Nowcast + lag_temp (leakage) — missingness: n/a. AUROC 0.9302, sensitivity 0.8905, PPV 0.6661 at threshold 0.43 (5-fold property-level CV, n=250). Flats AUROC 0.8996 vs terraced 0.9205. Adding lag_temp inflates AUROC +0.089 (row-split 0.9316); lag_temp is ~yesterday's target = leakage. NOT READY.

overall_notes: Evaluated 6 models across algorithm and missing-data-handling choices. Deploy the sensor-robust Random Forest (AUROC 0.9129); the logistic baseline was much less reliable for flats (0.6784 vs 0.8642 for the forest), so model choice — not abandoning flats — closes most of the equity gap. Adding CO2 lifts AUROC by at most +0.003 within a fixed model, so its 38% MNAR gap is a data-integrity issue (repair 40 sensors), not a ranking bias. lag_temp is target leakage and is excluded. Data quality CONDITIONAL, split integrity READY, equity CONDITIONAL.
